group.passage:
Since the year of 1927, TIME magazine has annually selected a Person of the Year, who represents the individual most influencing the headlines over the past year. Traditionally, this honor has often been awarded to male figures, mostly politicians or business magnates. [[1]]
However, in 2023, the person that emerged as the most distinguished and the brightest star defied these conventional roles entirely. Taylor Swift was everywhere in 2023, breaking records and filling stadiums. She reached a never-before-seen level of impact, blending artistry and commerce in an incomparable manner. She has obtained matchless achievements, including notching more No. 1 albums than any other female artist in history. [[2]] Particularly significant was Swift’s ability to create a space for thousands and thousands of people to rediscover the communal experiences that were taken from us during the pandemic, offering joy to the fans each night at her monumentally successful Eras Tour. Swift transcended national borders to become a ray of positivity for countless individuals. Her ability to connect with people on a global scale surpasses that of any other contemporary figure. [[3]] Literal effect caused by her fans, who call themselves Swifties, was shown on data everywhere.
Moreover, Swift’s impact extended beyond mere statistics. She bravely embraced her own vulnerabilities, inspiring others to do the same and fostering a sense of self-awareness among her audience. Through her own journey, she crafted a narrative that resonated with millions and provided them with not just entertainment but also a mirror for self-reflection.
[[4]] For her remarkable ability to create a world that embraced diversity and brought happiness to a society in need, Taylor Swift rightfully earned the title of TIME’s 2023 Person of the Year.

options_bank.B: Numerous U.S. Presidents, leaders of Russia or Popes have been receivers of this recognition.
options_bank.C: Through entertaining and songwriting, this talented artist did what she loves and does better than others.
options_bank.D: Some may attribute Swift’s success to the planets and the fate, but that just overlooks her good ideas and power moves.
